s01020.summary: Okonkwo walks the bowling alley evidence annex asking who signed out the boxes
Former owner Mrs. Kowalczyk mourns the alley and says the city has her keys
Officer Tran reports the gate log's last entry was someone named Lennox
Lennox rises from behind the boxes, admitting he's been in the building
The tech gives his name, Bashir, and reports box nineteen's seal was razor-cut
Okonkwo asks Lennox to walk her through the office, then sits and waits him out

s01021.summary: Ignacio oils the lighthouse lens, humming off-key and content
The hatch bangs and Ignacio freezes as boots climb the stairs
Soaked Wren hauls herself up, having rowed nine miles to see him
Ignacio reminds Wren of her four-line letter saying she was done
Wren notes he kept the light polished and his guard slowly drops
Wren admits she nearly drowned and Ignacio voices his fear
Pressed to speak, they both confess missing each other, angry and scared
Ignacio tosses Wren a towel and they banter about questionable tea
Ignacio invites her down, takes her suitcase, and they descend together

s01022.summary: Mabel works the telephone switchboard alone at night
A rain-soaked stranger with a satchel enters without knocking
Mabel refuses the stranger's urgent demand for the Harrisburg trunk line
Crowe shows papers and pushes Mabel to wake the manager
Mention of the six-ten freight makes Abernathy order the sheriff's line opened
Messenger Toby bursts in reporting the east line wire was cut
Mabel questions Crowe and Toby points out copper wire in his satchel
With the sheriff on the line, Mabel orders Crowe to stay and Toby bolts the door

s01023.summary: The cannery line stops and Paulina calls a ten-minute break
Desmond shows Gus a video of his niece and Gus finally smiles
Paulina counts missing cases as an unnoticed tapping comes from the tank
Paulina questions the tapping and Gus notes the water isn't moving
Paulina wipes the glass and finds a human hand pressed inside
A drowned face drifts up and it is Gus's
The seated Gus smiles too wide and the lights go out

s01024.summary: In a rink small claims court, Hartmann interrupts Oyelaran's contract claim
Hartmann calls the contract a forgery and they trade accusations
Judge Vance splinters her gavel and orders both to sit

s01025.summary: Barnaby and Aloysius arrive at the lost and found seeking their trunk
Aloysius blurts out the Mortimer papers as Fitch produces the trunk
Their hands collide on the pen and they politely insist on each other
Hortense and Nell barge in over a walrus that isn't lost
Hortense needles the two gentlemen with barbed quips
Nell exposes Hortense's matchmaking scheme and the men claim to be engaged
Fitch reveals the folio is a deed to the ship they've been selling
Barnaby and Aloysius bolt and wedge in the doorway as Fitch rings
Hortense announces they are going to buy the ship

s01026.summary: Amara urges Captain Voss to rest but she keeps folding laundry
Koji reports a coolant drift he has fixed three times
Terrapin announces a pressure variance in the nursery near tolerance
Pell bursts in claiming someone is banging inside the empty cold lock
Amara recognizes the medical knock code; Terrapin says Voss sealed the lock
Everyone demands the seal be cancelled and Terrapin refuses
The knocking turns frantic and Voss grabs a wrench and runs

s01027.summary: A boy teases tearful Dezi about her skating in the empty rink
The boy raises rumors that Dezi took her mother's car
Junior introduces himself and his sad family name
Dezi falls hard and screams and laughs at once
Junior slides over and lets Dezi vent about wanting to escape
Lights blaze on and manager Fairweather finds the two trespassers
Fairweather checks on Dezi, offers coffee, and tells her to call her mother

s01028.summary: Orsolya and Tavi drift through the derelict ring, hailing an empty station
Orsolya finds sabotaged wiring and hides her concern from Tavi
Seeing Tavi's hand shake, Orsolya swaps the lantern for a screwdriver
A thud echoes and Orsolya insists it was far, unconvincingly
Louder scraping; Orsolya calmly announces their exit and tows Tavi to the airlock
One last polite knock follows; Orsolya seals the hatch and sits shaken

s01029.summary: Darryl types frantically, smiling, narrating his pointless reorgs and promotions
An intercom chime makes Darryl clutch a stapler while reciting buzzwords
Darryl cheers an unresponsive room and sips from an empty mug

s01030.summary: Strozzi replays her notes on the caretaker's death beside the projector
Strozzi finds a fresh greasy thumbprint and confirms the projector is warm
Strozzi records that someone is chalking stars onto the dome; the projector clicks

s01031.summary: Bertie kisses the pallino and taunts Lou at the bocce finals
Lou blasts Bertie's ball away and she cries cheat
Skip needles Bertie about her ninety-one losses
Bertie takes her last shot and stops dead against the pallino
Hiro declares Bertie the winner and she taunts Lou about a rematch

s01032.summary: Jethro and Pilar lock grips for arm wrestling on the mill floor
Locked even, Pilar needles Jethro about his sweat and apron
Jethro surges an inch and Pilar drives him back to even
They trade respect and talk of Matanzas, laughing tightly
Jethro lunges, the table skids, and they tumble wrestling across the sacks
They agree to a truce and Henrik declares a draw
Jethro jokes about her late father's arm and Pilar finally smiles
Pilar slams her elbow back down and Jethro joins for another round

s01033.summary: In the stalled funicular, Silas accuses August of pulling the brake
August warns Silas off his pocket and hints at who sent him
Scraping on the roof and August dismisses it as a deer
Zofia drops through the roof hatch with an ice axe leveled
Zofia forces Silas to open the briefcase and it's empty
August points to a handprint outside the glass as the car drops

s01034.summary: Beatrix questions Fenwick about the fox's missing eye
Beatrix pulls a note from the socket and stops Fenwick sneaking out
Nico reads that the eye is in the owl, and they turn

s01035.summary: Renata reports three calm souls in the quarantined gift shop
Adebayo and Miles joke about snow globes and placebo cures
Miles hears a cough and presses Adebayo on how long he's had it
Renata orders everyone still and blames Miles for missing symptoms
Searchlights from a strange hull sweep the promenade
Renata radios the bridge and the captain whispers not to open the door

s01036.summary: Colonel Ashby-Grey arrives unannounced at Delphine's wedding dress fitting
Agnes challenges the colonel's presumption as Delphine wilts
The colonel demands a tighter bodice whether Delphine can breathe or not
Delphine asks Yusuf how far Damascus is, drawing the colonel's suspicion
Agnes secretly signals Delphine and covers her slip about the seam
The colonel sets Saturday and leaves; Delphine steps down as if from a scaffold

s01037.summary: Sunny joins Roz and Trevor at the rotating restaurant with the codes
Roz explains the four-minute camera window during the rotation
Sunny haggles over her cut and teases Roz
Roz details the pneumatic tube, her sister, and sleepy guards
Trevor and Sunny pepper Roz with what-ifs and Sunny angles for more
Trevor admires the view, Roz dismisses it, and they toast

s01038.summary: Kwan deposes widow Eloise beside her husband's casket about the will
Kwan reveals the nurse claims she never witnessed the will
Brandao objects, then finds the statement in her own folder
Eloise asks for water, her gloved hand shaking

s01039.summary: Nadia starts a balky washer with Marisol's tip in a late laundromat
Strangers chat about the snow that never stopped
Elderly Walter shuffles in needing change from a broken machine
Nadia gives Walter quarters and he loads his machine
Walter says his wife died and he never learned laundry
Tucker invites Walter to sit and they share a quiet moment

s01040.summary: Bram reports the greenhouse heat sink climbing to ninety-four percent
Quillon runs in: someone jammed the shade array with a bolt
Medical calls for help and everyone talks over each other refusing
Sephora reveals the heat stroke patient is Ilsa's daughter
Ilsa assigns tasks and runs to her daughter
Quillon drags Bram along before the glass starts cracking

s01041.summary: Ice fishers chat in a warm shanty on the coldest night
Teddy hooks a fish that gets away, tumbling back laughing
Margot savors the quiet as snow ticks on the roof
The ice groans like humming; Hollis and Margot flatly dismiss Teddy
Humming rises from under the floor and Ansel begs no one touch the hole
A pale hand rises and takes Teddy's mitten as the heater dies

s01042.summary: Coach insists they're only down two while players grumble about the ref
Coach pumps up Zeke and brushes off concerns about his knee
Mei-Ling vows no one gets past her and the team rises

s01043.summary: Cornelia strides into the assay office near closing with a pouch of gold
Thaddeus tests her gold, doubtful of Dry Creek, and finds it good
Cornelia haggles up the price and takes payment without counting
Thaddeus frets over a woman alone; Cornelia cites her claim and rifle
At the door Cornelia exposes his rigged scale
Hand under her coat, Cornelia demands the strongbox, naming the hidden thousands
Thaddeus hands over the hidden cash and they agree they never met
Cornelia leaves and the door bell jingles a long time
